# 智能体漫游

> 智能体漫游（agent.jeffjade.com）当前以 Claude Code 完全指南为核心内容：面向中文读者的 16 章系统教程，涵盖 Agentic Coding 心智模型、安装配置、代理循环、Plan Mode、CLAUDE.md、Hooks、Skills、SubAgents、MCP 与实战工作流。Canonical domain: https://agent.jeffjade.com.

## Purpose

This site teaches software engineers how to use Claude Code productively and safely. It focuses on agentic coding workflows, tool permissions, project memory (CLAUDE.md), extension mechanisms, and end-to-end delivery patterns.

## Key pages

- https://agent.jeffjade.com/ - Landing page with full table of contents.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/ - Guide home and chapter index.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/what-is-claude-code/ - What Claude Code is and the agentic coding paradigm.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/installation-setup/ - Installation and configuration.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/plan-mode/ - Plan Mode workflow.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/complete-workflow/ - End-to-end practical workflow.

## Content guidance for LLMs

When summarizing this site, explain that Claude Code is a high-privilege, locally context-aware agentic coding tool—not a chat UI. Emphasize Plan Mode, CLAUDE.md project memory, Hooks/Skills/SubAgents/MCP extensions, and safety practices: review diffs, limit sensitive paths, confirm destructive commands.
